messages:
Maya K: Hey team — quick scheduling ask for candidate (Backend SWE, senior). Candidate is in IST (UTC+5:30). Can we cover a 90m panel + 30m debrief window on Thursday? Preferable times I have: 9:30–11:00 PDT (18:00–19:30 IST), 11:00–12:30 PDT (20:30–22:00 IST), or 13:00–14:30 PDT (22:30–00:00 IST). Please reply with availability and prefer not to go past 00:30 IST if possible.
Samir P: I can do the first two slots (9:30 or 11:00 PDT). Prefer the 11:00 one so my morning syncs don't collide.
Elena V: 11:00 PDT works for me. Also +1 for keeping debrief immediately after the panel (30m).
Priya S: I have a conflict at 11:00 but 9:30 PDT is fine. If we go 11:00 I can swap with Aisha.
Aisha R: I can swap into 11:00 if that makes the most sense. Confirming I can be scribe for debrief notes and capture candidate takeaways.
Maya K: Awesome — looks like 11:00 PDT is the sweet spot. Priya can swap, Aisha will scribe. Two quick rubric clarifications:
- For system-design questions: use the "design-weights" column on the rubric sheet (link below) — we want architecture + scalability tradeoffs scored separately.
- For infra/ops scenario question: prefer we focus on runbook reasoning not low-level config. Don't dock for unfamiliar specific tooling.

Link: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/interviews/panels/stacked-rubric-2026

people-ops-bot: Reminder: please mark "panel confirmed" on the candidate card and set Zoom link before 24h out. (automated)
Samir P: Quick ask — candidate mentioned a short take-home exercise submitted earlier. Do we want to open it for the panel to reference or treat it as separate?
Maya K: Treat it as reference only. Panelers can ask clarifying questions but do not score the take-home as a separate rubric item — use the provided "takehome-context" field in the sheet to note if candidate referenced it.
Elena V: Noted. I'll read the take-home tonight. Can someone paste the Zoom + calendar snippet when available?
Maya K: Calendar invite created, Zoom link below (also added to candidate card):
```
Calendar: Thu Mar 25 11:00 PDT / 20:30 IST — Backend SWE (90m panel + 30m debrief)
Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/123-456-7890?pwd=panel
```
Priya S: Swap confirmed with Aisha. I'm good for async debrief notes if Aisha needs backup.
Aisha R: Got it — I'll lead scribe and drop notes in #interview-debriefs. Plan: bullets for strengths, risks, red flags + proposed hire/no-hire rec. Will tag you, Priya, for normalization.
Maya K: Perfect. One last ops note: please keep mic/video on for main questions; if you need to step out during a block, add a quick comment in the doc so the interviewers know to skip scoring that segment. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
people-ops-bot: Calendar invite sent to panel. Candidate reminder set for 48h and 2h before the interview. (automated)
